PTree.Interp.StateFoldFacts.state_fold_square
endpoints.type:
@StateFoldFacts.state_fold_square
     : forall (S : Type) (E MN T : Type -> Type) (MT : Monad.Monad T) (QT : Monad.Eq1 T),
       @Monad.Eq1Equivalence T MT QT ->
       @Monad.MonadLawsE T QT MT ->
       forall (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> T X) (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> T X)
         (A : Type) (st : S * PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A),
       @Monad.eq1 T QT (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (S * A) + S * A)
         (@Monad.bind T MT (S * PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A + S * A)
            (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (S * A) + S * A)
            (@StateFoldFacts.state_fold_step S E MN T MT handle sample A st)
            (fun v : S * PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A + S * A =>
             @Monad.ret T MT (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (S * A) + S * A)
               (@IterationLaws.iteration_map
                  (S * PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A)
                  (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (S * A)) (S * A)
                  (fun st0 : S * PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A =>
                   @State.run_state S E MN A
                     (@snd S (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A) st0)
                     (@fst S (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A) st0)) v)))
         (@Fold.fold_step E MN T MT handle sample (S * A)
            (@State.run_state S E MN A
               (@snd S (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A) st)
               (@fst S (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A) st)))

PTree.Execution.ITreeFold.itree_iteration_uniform
PTree.Execution.ITreeFold.itree_fold_unfold
endpoints.type:
@ITreeFold.itree_fold_unfold
     : forall (E MN F : Type -> Type) (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A),
       @Eqit.eutt F A A (@eq A)
         (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A t)
         (@ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A + A) A
            (@Fold.fold_step E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) handle
               sample A t)
            (fun v : PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A + A =>
             match v with
             | @inl _ _ u =>
                 @Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
                   (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A u
             | @inr _ _ a =>
                 {|
                   ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                     @ITreeDefinition.RetF F A (ITreeDefinition.itree F A) a
                 |}
             end))

endpoints.name: PTree.Execution.ITreeFold.itree_fold_vis
endpoints.type:
@ITreeFold.itree_fold_vis
     : forall (E MN F : Type -> Type) (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A X : Type) (e : E X) (k : X -> PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A),
       @Eqit.eutt F A A (@eq A)
         (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A
            {|
              PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                @PTreeDefinition.VisF E MN A (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A) X e k
            |})
         (@ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F X A (handle X e)
            (fun x : X =>
             @Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
               (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A (k x)))

endpoints.name: PTree.Regression.Semantics.StateFold.state_fold_commutes
endpoints.type:
@StateFold.state_fold_commutes
     : forall (S : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type)
         (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A)
         (s : S),
       @Eqit.eutt F (S * A) (S * A) (@eq (S * A))
         (@StateFold.fold_state S E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A t s)
         (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample (S * A)
            (@State.run_state S E MN A t s))

endpoints.name: PTree.Regression.Semantics.StateFold.state_get_fold
endpoints.type:
@StateFold.state_get_fold
     : forall (S : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type)
         (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A : Type) (k : S -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A)
         (s : S),
       @Eqit.eutt F (S * A) (S * A) (@eq (S * A))
         (@StateFold.fold_state S E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A
            {|
              PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                @PTreeDefinition.VisF (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A
                  (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE S) E) MN A) S
                  (@Sum.inl1 (State.stateE S) E S (State.Get S)) k
            |} s)
         (@StateFold.fold_state S E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A (k s) s)

       @Eqit.eutt F (nat * unit) (nat * unit) (@eq (nat * unit))
         (@StateFold.fold_state nat Sum.void1 Representation.SubEnumQ (ITreeDefinition.itree F)

         (@Fold.fold Sum.void1 Representation.SubEnumQ (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F)
            (@StateFold.no_visible_event F) sample (nat * unit)
            (@State.run_state nat Sum.void1 Representation.SubEnumQ unit
               StateCounter.count_until_success s))
